ADR-0009 (world frame anchored at the entrance), ADR-0010 (the room nearer the entrance owns the shared wall) and ADR-0011 (visible is not addressable, Proposed until the picking confinement is exercised in play) written in 8b3b1eb; index updated and the back-fill note narrowed to 0001-0008. RoomView.coveredWalls ships Rooms.coveredWalls()' answer and room.gd omits exactly those segments — the crypt's north corners are stone from the gallery, every plane is drawn once by the same room from either side, and the A-B-C plane two neighbours both used to drop is drawn. The doorway is the deliberate exception: a door is one object two rooms address by two ids and World._target_under only scans the current room's walls, so the room the party is in hangs it and every other room leaves its openings open. Room.build takes the current room id rather than a Level so that the agreed DIM-to-LIT fallback cannot hang a second door. Five TDD'd tests, all three client ones mutation-checked against the old direction-match rule. AGENTS.md, ADR-0010 and CONTEXT.md amended. Filed emberdelve-xgg.9 for the generator-era case where a covering room is not on the wire.
waysOut() now states every listed exit is open, unlocked and crossable outside a fight; gallery door-south no longer says shut. Two tests lock it. Server suite green.
